info.title: Traqen Traceability API
info.description: API for project and Snapshot bootstrap, deterministic fact ingestion, controlled Reverse Skill runs, authorized statement-level governance, server-derived Feature traceability, layered Snapshot impact, TestSpec validation, and attested execution Evidence ingestion. The production server requires an API token; Decision and candidate-review operations additionally fail closed without configured reviewer identity.

200.description: Independent platform operational observations and explicit unavailable signals
Project Snapshot Manifests ordered newest first
Latest governed Feature versions and discovery summaries
Human-governed aliases for the stable Feature ID
Snapshot-bound conflicts derived from the governed Feature traceability model
Snapshot-bound Feature trace chains and explicit gaps
Latest feature version with current claims, decision history, linked TestSpecs, and trace chains
Matching facts plus their one-hop graph neighbors
Current registration state for every installed Skill version

parameters.name: async
parameters.description: Runs asynchronously by default so large Workspaces can checkpoint and resume. Set false for bounded synchronous execution.

200.description: Immutable analyzed Feature versions and retirement events ordered from oldest to newest

parameters.name: async
parameters.description: When true (or Prefer: respond-async is sent), persist and return an asynchronous job.

BearerAuth.description: Production API token. Reviewer routes can instead reserve Authorization for reviewer identity and send the API token through ApiToken.

ProjectCreated.description: Organization, tenant, project, and principals created idempotently

SnapshotRegistered.description: Server-derived immutable Snapshot manifest registered for the project

PayloadTooLarge.description: Request body exceeds the configured limit

Conflict.description: The append conflicts with immutable history or a required reference

RunnerUnauthorized.description: Runner attestation is missing, unknown, or invalid

ScannerUnauthorized.description: Scanner attestation is missing, unknown, or invalid

SkillUnauthorized.description: Skill publisher attestation is missing, unknown, or invalid

ReviewerUnauthenticated.description: A trusted reviewer identity could not be established

ReviewerForbidden.description: The reviewer role or outcome is not allowed by project policy

TestSpecCreated.description: TestSpec draft or approved version appended

TestSpecGenerated.description: Unapproved TestSpec draft deterministically converted from an authorized Claim and mapped Endpoint Fact

ExecutionEvidenceStored.description: Attested execution and verified Evidence appended atomically

ExecutionEvidenceFound.description: Execution, verified Evidence, and Runner attestation

ReverseRunFound.description: Reverse run with raw/normalized Skill outputs, merge results, conflicts, and audit history

ReverseRunJob.description: Durable asynchronous Reverse Run job projection with ordered status and cancellation events

AnalysisRunCheckpoint.description: Durable Analysis Agent checkpoint with bounded WorkUnits and restart-safe progress

AnalysisRunResult.description: Latest Feature projection produced from deterministic Facts and optional evidence-bounded model/Skill analysis

CandidateReviewed.description: Append-only candidate review and any atomically created baseline records

ImplementationReanalyzed.description: Authorized reanalysis binds an existing normative Claim to current Snapshot Facts without replacing its Decision

CandidateReviewList.description: Append-only statement-level reviews for a ReverseRun

FeatureTraceability.description: Server-derived Feature view with independent dimensions, Fact mappings, proof chains, and explicit gaps

BusinessProcessModel.description: Authorized immutable business actors, states, transitions, exceptions, and Snapshot-bound implementation mappings

DecisionReviewCase.description: Append-only governed Decision review with separation of duties, approvals, lifecycle events, and materialized authority

EvidenceRetentionPolicy.description: Immutable Evidence retention and access policy with server-owned authority

EvidenceLifecycle.description: Event-replayed Evidence archive, Legal Hold, deletion-proof, and access-audit state

FeatureGraph.description: Bounded Feature-centered graph projection with typed provenance and progressive expansion metadata

FeatureGraphPath.description: Bounded deterministic path between two authorized nodes in a Feature graph

ChangeImpact.description: Immutable Snapshot comparison with deterministic implementation invalidations and preserved business truth

ContinuousProtection.description: Server-derived incremental regression selection and policy-controlled quality gate without a composite trust score

ProductEffectivenessMetrics.description: Snapshot-bound effectiveness metrics with independent rates, gap causes, freshness, and explicit unavailable external inputs
